scope: Theorem 13.10 (A fixed box test with recorded pointers) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 67. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On R3, the fixed label (2, 0, 0) and open box (0, 1)2 × (−1/2, 1/2) realize halting by an effective general force with compact spatial support, zero initial velocity and pressure, bounded mixed derivatives, and period one after time one. The construction moves whole solid boxes. Uniqueness holds among smooth competitors with u ∈ C1 ([0, T]; L2 ), ∇u, ∆u ∈ C([0, T]; L2 ), p, ∇p ∈ C([0, T]; L2 ), sup [0,T]×R3 (|u| + |∇u|) < ∞ for every finite T.
